detail.body:
## Purpose

`tests/v1/determinism/test_nvfp4_batch_invariant.py::test_dense_nvfp4_generation_is_deterministic_across_batch_sizes_e2e` compares the needle prompt's logprobs across batch sizes with `torch.testing.assert_close(needle_logprobs, baseline_logprobs)`, i.e. with the default fp32 tolerances (`rtol=1.3e-6`, `atol=1e-5`). Batch invariance means bitwise-identical results, which is what every other test in `tests/v1/determinism/test_batch_invariance.py` checks with `torch.equal`. With the tolerance the NVFP4 test can pass while the NVFP4 GEMM is in fact batch dependent.

This PR replaces the comparison with `torch.equal` and prints both logprob lists on failure. No product code changes.

## Test Plan

- `tests/v1/determinism/test_nvfp4_batch_invariant.py` with the default model (`nm-testing/TinyLlama-1.1B-Chat-v1.0-NVFP4`), before and after the change, with the default settings and with `VLLM_NVFP4_NEEDLE_TRIALS=5 VLLM_NVFP4_NEEDLE_BATCH_SIZE=32`, on one GB300 (SM103) GPU.
- Supporting evidence that NVFP4 checkpoints are bitwise batch invariant on Blackwell with the current kernels: online bs=1-vs-batched logprob checks for `nvidia/Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct-FP4` and `nvidia/Qwen3-30B-A3B-FP4` at TP=1 and TP=4 on `main` (`d09ff77637`).

## Test Result

The "after" runs were made on a GB300 checkout of `main` that also carries the local patches of the separate PRs #61035/#61036/#61037/#61038 (none of them touch this test or the NVFP4 kernels); the `COMMIT:` lines show the base commit and the number of locally changed files. The "before" runs are on a clean `main` checkout.

Note: with `VLLM_TEST_NVFP4_MODEL=nvidia/Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct-FP4` the test cannot start on SM100 in batch-invariant mode because it pins `FLASH_ATTN` and that checkpoint enables an FP8 KV cache (`FLASH_ATTN is not valid for this configuration. Reason: ['kv_cache_dtype not supported', 'FP8 KV cache requires FA3 on SM90, FA4 with head_size=512 on SM90, or FA4 on SM100']`); that is independent of this change and is why the supporting evidence above uses the server with automatic backend selection (`TRITON_ATTN`).

@@ -93,7 +93,12 @@ def test_dense_nvfp4_generation_is_deterministic_across_batch_sizes_e2e(backend)
             assert baseline_logprobs is not None
             assert needle_completion.token_ids == baseline_completion.token_ids
             assert needle_completion.text == baseline_completion.text
-            torch.testing.assert_close(needle_logprobs, baseline_logprobs)
+            # Batch invariance means bitwise-identical logprobs, not merely
+            # close ones (see test_batch_invariance.py).
+            assert torch.equal(needle_logprobs, baseline_logprobs), (
+                f"Logprobs differ at batch size {batch_size}: "
+                f"{needle_logprobs.tolist()} vs {baseline_logprobs.tolist()}"
+            )
